title: Devices
description: Every device registered on the network, with its security checks, whether it answers, and whether it is blocked.
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, address or type…

posture.allUnverified: No device has reported its security checks yet, so all of them show as unverified.
posture.passed: Checks passed, as reported by the device

kind.profile: Phone or computer with the WireGuard app

empty.title: No devices found
empty.body: Add your first device to get started.

filtered.title: No devices match these filters
filtered.body: Change or clear the filters to see more.

loadFailed.title: Devices could not be loaded
loadFailed.body: The list did not load. Try again.

actionFailed: This was not completed. Try again shortly.

detail.pick: Choose a device to see its details here.
detail.gatewayLocked: This device is a gateway for WireGuard profiles. Revoking it would disconnect the devices it serves. Move them to another gateway and remove this one from the gateways in Settings first.
detail.description: Details for one device: security checks, addresses, a connection test, and actions to block it or disconnect it.
detail.alert: This device is blocked and cannot communicate with any other device on the network.
detail.testFailed: Test failed: the device did not respond. Try again.
detail.blockBody: The device cannot communicate with the network until the block is removed. Nothing is deleted. Enter a reason (optional):
detail.revokeBody: The device is disconnected immediately. Its key will no longer be accepted by other devices on the network. This cannot be undone.
detail.loadFailed: The device could not be loaded. Try again.
detail.title: Device details

location.title: Location
location.label: Country
location.failed: The location was not saved. Check the country and try again.
location.notice: Nothing measures where a device is. The country appears only when an administrator or the device operator stated it.

response.title: Response time
response.deviceAnswerHelp: The gateway that serves this device pings it through the tunnel about every 30 seconds. No reply is not the same as disconnected: Windows blocks ping by default.
response.meshNotMeasured: Not measured. Only devices that use the WireGuard app are pinged from their gateway.
response.consoleLinkHelp: How long the last heartbeat from this device took to reach the console. It is not how fast the device answers.

test.noReply: No reply within 3 seconds, but the device is connected: last contact {{ago}}. Windows blocks ping by default, so a connected device may not answer.
test.neverConnected: Not connected. This device has never been in contact.
test.gatewayUnreachable: The gateway that serves this device did not answer. Try again shortly.
test.unsupported: This device cannot be tested from here: only devices that use the WireGuard app are pinged from their gateway.
test.rateLimited: Wait a moment before testing again.

gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.none: No gateway serves this device. Add one in Settings.
gateway.warning: After the move, this device cannot connect until its WireGuard profile is replaced. A WireGuard profile names one gateway, so the person must import a new profile on the device.
gateway.done: {{device}} now goes through {{gateway}}. Until its profile is replaced it cannot connect. Ask the person to add the device again from their page, or to change the peer of the tunnel in the WireGuard app to:
gateway.failed: The device was not moved. Try again.
gateway.noOther: There is no other gateway. Add one in Settings.
gateway.onlyAdmin: Only an administrator can move a device to another gateway.
gateway.loadFailed: The gateways could not be loaded.
